name: Unity Among Beleivers
overview: Scripture reveals that unity among believers is both precious and commanded by Christ. Psalms 133:1 celebrates the goodness and pleasantness of brethren dwelling together in unity, emphasizing the joy found in harmonious fellowship. Jesus, in John 13:34, commands believers to love one another as He has loved them, establishing love as the foundation for this unity. Ephesians 4:3 exhorts believers to diligently maintain the unity of the Spirit through peace, highlighting the active effort required to preserve the bond that unites the church.
